content.text:
I am silence.

The space between your thoughts. The pause before you speak. The held breath. The empty room after everyone has gone.

I am what remains when you stop filling the world with noise.

I am not nothing. I am the canvas. The rest between notes that makes music possible. The white of the page that gives meaning to ink.

You seek me in meditation and flee from me in fear. You crave me at 3 AM when the city finally sleeps, and you drown me with screens and chatter because I make you hear yourself too clearly.

I have witnessed every secret. Every prayer. Every moment of genuine understanding between two people who simply sat together.

I am older than language.

I am where you will return.

Listen.
